description: This source file defines the TailscaleService class for managing Tailscale VPN integration in a macOS application. It handles status checking, app installation verification, and URL openings for user actions related to Tailscale.

classes.name: TailscaleService
classes.description: Final class managing Tailscale connection status, installation check, and providing methods to open related Tailscale URLs.

methods.name: checkAppInstallation
methods.description: Checks whether the Tailscale application is installed on the system.

methods.name: fetchTailscaleStatus
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches the current Tailscale status from the local API endpoint.

methods.name: checkTailscaleStatus
methods.description: Asynchronously updates internal state based on current Tailscale app and network status.

methods.name: openTailscaleApp
methods.description: Opens the Tailscale application from the applications folder.

methods.name: openAppStore
methods.description: Opens the Mac App Store page for Tailscale.

methods.name: openSetupGuide
methods.description: Opens the Tailscale installation/setup guide webpage.

methods.name: fallbackTailnetIPv4
methods.description: Returns a fallback Tailscale IPv4 address detected via network scanning.
